title: Health & Medical Tech
tagline: EHR systems, telemedicine, and health datasets
description: DHIS2 powers Nepal's national HMIS — one of the few government systems with a documented API. Possible Health/Nyaya Health's Bahmni-based open EHR is the strongest open-source health-IT case study in Nepal. Telemedicine is led by Hamro Doctor and Cura Health.

resources.name: DHIS2 Nepal HMIS
resources.description: National Health Management Information System on DHIS2 since 2016. 1,000+ facilities reporting. DHIS2 Web API at /api.

resources.name: Possible Health / NepalEHR
resources.description: Open-source EHR using Bahmni (OpenMRS+OpenELIS+OpenERP) + CommCare + DHIS2. First international Bahmni implementation (Bayalpata Hospital, 2015).

resources.name: Bahmni
resources.description: Open-source EHR + hospital system. Adopted by Nyaya Health Nepal.

resources.name: openIMIS Nepal
resources.description: Open-source insurance management — claims and beneficiary management.

resources.name: Hamro Doctor
resources.description: Pioneer telemedicine platform since 2016. 1,000+ NMC-verified doctors.

resources.name: DDA / DAMS Drug Registry
resources.description: Department of Drug Administration's authoritative drug registry.

resources.name: MoHP COVID Dashboard
resources.description: Ministry of Health and Population COVID-19 dashboard (now archived).
